folds.title: A chat is a postcard
points: Be careful what you paste into any AI tool.
Treat a chat box like a public postcard, not a private diary.

folds.title: Never paste secrets
points: No passwords, API keys or secret tokens.
If Claude needs to see the shape of one, use a placeholder like `YOUR_API_KEY`.

folds.title: Think twice about
points: Check your workplace or school rules first.

folds.title: Same help, nothing private

chat.label: Before
chat.you: I'm Priya Shah, account 4471 2290. Why was I charged twice?

chat.label: After
chat.you: My bank charged me twice for one purchase. How do I ask for a refund?

folds.note: Claude can help just as well with the second one.

folds.title: Safe habits
items: Remove names and numbers you do not need.
Check settings for how your chats are used.

folds.prompt: Fine to paste, or never paste?

items.text: A paragraph from my own blog post
items.why: It is your own text and not private.
Passwords never belong in a chat.

items.text: A recipe I want scaled for 6 people
A key like sk-12345 from my app
items.why: Keys give others access. Use a placeholder.

items.text: A customer list with phone numbers
items.why: It holds other people's private data.
